nonBlockingIssues.description: cleanup_empty_entities() and clear_entities() do not emit EntityEvent::Destroyed. By design, not required by spec.
test_entity_events_visible_during_update uses assert!(true) — doesn't verify system actually saw events.
collect_changed_entity_ids iterates all entities with any component, not just queried types. Minor perf note for large worlds.
query_ref() accepts any QueryData including &mut T but mutable queries would be UB. No compile-time guard. Documented restriction, no misuse at call sites.
Tangential NDC Y-axis bug fix bundled with query conversion commit. Correct and well-tested but violates one-change-per-commit convention.

appliedUpdates.description: Added ECS event system, change detection, UnsafeCell World internals, and QueryData trait maintenance sections to architecture.md

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Consider adding guidance to scope cargo fmt to the modified crate only ('cargo fmt -p <crate>') rather than formatting the whole workspace, to avoid mixing unrelated formatting changes with feature commits.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: entity-lifecycle-events worker ran 'cargo fmt' workspace-wide, causing unrelated katla_gfx formatting changes to be mixed into the feature commit.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Reinforce the 'one logical change per commit' convention. Small tangential bug fixes should be separate commits, not bundled with feature work.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: query-conversion worker included an NDC Y-axis bug fix in the feature commit. The fix was correct and tested but unrelated to query conversion.
